caption: The drawing consists of multiple outlined shapes on a beige background, rendered with thin, precise lines in a medium gray color. The shapes are arranged within a rectangular border. In the upper left corner, there are two irregular quadrilateral shapes adjacent to each other, both with curved edges and dashed interior lines; below them are several smaller, narrow rectangular pieces of different lengths, some with arrows, numbering, and cross markings. To the right, there is a large, rounded, asymmetrical piece with several notches and a dashed curved line, labeled with text and numbers. The bottom half of the drawing contains three large vertical panels, each roughly trapezoidal, labeled “D,” “D-1,” and “D-2,” each featuring a few horizontal dashed lines and numerals along the lower portion, as well as additional markings along the left and right edges. There are notations, text, and measurement lines spread throughout the drawing, and all of the objects appear to be garment pattern pieces laid out for reference.
title: Girl's Dress (Pattern)
